home.hero_subtitle: We are a cooperative platform connecting producers, industry, and community to develop the potential of hemp in Costa Rica.
home.b1_desc: Regenerative crops that benefit the soil and the environment.
home.b2_desc: A fair model that empowers local farmers.
home.b3_desc: Hemp products of the highest purity and standards.
home.b4_desc: Cutting-edge technology applied to agricultural development.
home.mission_p1: At CoopeHemp, we believe in the transformative power of hemp — not just as a crop, but as a driver of social and environmental change.
home.mission_p2: Our cooperative unites forces to ensure fair practices, continuous education, and products that improve quality of life while healing the land.
home.products_sub: Discover the versatility of hemp in our line of premium products.
home.cta_title: Ready to be part of the change?
home.cta_sub: Join our community of producers, investors, and conscious consumers.
home.keep_scrolling: Keep scrolling to explore all {{n}} stages
home.showcase_sub: Made with 100% organic hemp grown by our members in Costa Rica.
home.medical_p1: The endocannabinoid system — present in every human being — regulates pain, mood, sleep and the immune response. CBD activates its receptors without causing dependence or psychoactive effects.
home.medical_p2: Our full-spectrum oils preserve all the cannabinoids, terpenes and flavonoids of the flower, boosting the "entourage effect" for superior results.

antiinflamatorio.title: Anti-inflammatory
antiinflamatorio.desc: CBD inhibits inflammatory pathways without gastrointestinal side effects.

ansiolitico.title: Natural anxiolytic
ansiolitico.desc: Reduces cortisol and enhances the nervous system's GABA receptors.

neuroprotector.title: Neuroprotective
neuroprotector.desc: CBG shows promising effects in neuroprotection and cell regeneration.

sin-psicoactividad.title: No psychoactivity
sin-psicoactividad.desc: THC below 0.3%. All the benefits, no psychoactive effects.

home.cosmetic_p1: Hemp seed oil has a lipid profile that mimics the skin barrier's natural lipids, making it exceptionally compatible with human skin — it hydrates without clogging or disrupting the skin microbiome.
home.cosmetic_p2: Our cosmetic line is free of parabens, sulfates and silicones. Only natural actives that respect your skin and the planet.
cosmetic_benefits: Regulates oil production — ideal for combination skin
Rich in vitamin E: a powerful antioxidant
Suitable for sensitive skin, eczema and psoriasis
home.hempcrete_p1: Hemp hurd (the core of the hemp stalk) mixed with hydraulic lime produces Hempcrete: a biocomposite building material that is lighter than concrete, permanently sequesters carbon and improves over time.
home.hempcrete_p2: While conventional concrete emits CO₂, Hempcrete captures it. It is the only building material with a negative carbon footprint, growing stronger every year thanks to the lime's natural mineralization.

hempcrete_stats.label: CO₂ captured per m³ per year

hempcrete_cards.title: Hemp hurd
hempcrete_cards.desc: The crushed woody core of the stalk — 70% of the plant's biomass — is mixed with lime to create the compound.

hempcrete_cards.title: Natural carbonation
hempcrete_cards.desc: Over time the lime reacts with CO₂ in the air and the silica in the hurd, turning into ever-harder stone.

hempcrete_cards.title: Full life cycle
hempcrete_cards.desc: At the end of its life, Hempcrete can be composted, becoming fertilizer for new hemp crops.

semilla.title: The Seed
semilla.subtitle: The most complete superfood on the planet
semilla.description: It all starts here. Hemp seed concentrates complete protein with all 9 essential amino acids and omegas 3, 6 and 9 in the ideal ratio for human metabolism — the same as breast milk.
facts: Source of zinc, magnesium and iron

raiz.title: Root & Soil
raiz.subtitle: Guardian of the ecosystem
raiz.description: Roots reach 2+ meters deep, breaking up compacted soils and absorbing heavy metals through active phytoremediation. Hemp needs no pesticides: its natural chemistry repels pests.

fibra-bast.title: Bast Fiber
fibra-bast.subtitle: Nature's strongest fiber
fibra-bast.description: The stalk's bark produces long, strong fibers called bast. They are the basis for technical textiles, industrial ropes, high-quality paper and bioengineering composites for the automotive industry.

agramiza.title: Hurd / Shiv
agramiza.subtitle: The raw material of Hempcrete
agramiza.description: The woody inner core of the stalk is mixed with hydraulic lime to produce Hempcrete: a building material that grows stronger over time, is fireproof, antibacterial and permanently captures carbon.
facts: Captures 1.6 t of CO₂ per m³/year

flor.title: The Flower
flor.subtitle: Nature's most complex pharmacy
flor.description: The flower's trichomes synthesize over 100 different cannabinoids. CBD, CBG, CBN and terpenes work in synergy — the "entourage effect" — exponentially boosting every therapeutic benefit.

extraccion.title: Extraction & Products
extraccion.subtitle: From the plant to the end consumer
extraccion.description: Through supercritical CO₂ extraction, cold pressing and certified artisanal processes, we transform every part of the plant into the highest-quality products for health, cosmetics and construction.

about.hero_sub: We blend tradition and innovation to build a sustainable future through hemp.
about.story_p1: CoopeHemp was born from the shared vision of Costa Rican farmers who saw hemp not only as a profitable crop, but as an opportunity to regenerate our land and empower our rural communities.
about.story_p2: Since our beginnings, we have dedicated ourselves to researching, educating and developing agricultural practices that respect natural cycles, ensuring products of the highest purity and quality.
about.pillars_sub: The foundations on which we build our commitment.
about.p1_desc: We implement circular economy models where every part of the plant is utilized, minimizing waste and maximizing value.
about.p2_desc: We develop products that meet the highest international standards, merging science and nature.
about.p3_desc: We foster local economic development, creating dignified jobs and growth opportunities for our communities.
about.v1_desc: We operate with total clarity in all our processes.
about.v3_desc: We pursue perfection in every product.
about.v4_desc: We believe in the power of teamwork.
about.cta_title: Be part of the green revolution
about.cta_sub: Whether you are a producer, investor, or consumer, there is a place for you in CoopeHemp.
